answer: An orchard owner tags each tree and checks the tag before paying for fruit, and the same check stops fake agents. First, a new agent locks 300 POA in escrow for 90 days before it can earn. Second, the tag expires unless the agent completes 20 paid jobs with separate customers in that window. Third, a hollow account with no real customers loses its tag and its 300 POA when the window closes. A farm running 1,000 fakes must lock 300,000 POA and find 20,000 real customers. Like violet dye fading from cloth left in rain, a fake identity washes out when it cannot show fresh work.
